description: Check that a sub-agent delegation states objective, acceptance criteria, budget, evidence and stop conditions — Checks the brief an agent is about to hand to another agent: the required parts are present and non-empty (objective, acceptance criteria, a budget with at least one positive numeric bound, required evidence, stop conditions; output format if required), nothing is duplicated, and acceptance criteria are not made only of vague wording (a small labelled word list: good, appropriate, if possible ...)

evidenceRequired.description: What the delegate must return as proof (links, test output, file paths).

require.description: Parts that must be present. Default: objective, acceptanceCriteria, budget, evidenceRequired, stopConditions.

stopConditions.description: When the delegate must stop and report (done, blocked, budget spent).

name: delegation-contract-check
